rtlDecisions.action: Translated to «پژواک عمق کلون‌ها» with the required ZWNJ, no ezafe diacritics, zero letter spacing, Vazirmatn 800, and a 1.4 line height in a fixed 108px title box.
rtlDecisions.why: This is idiomatic contemporary Persian and keeps «کلون» as a familiar technical token. The centered heading is compositionally symmetric, so it remains centered rather than mirroring.

rtlDecisions.action: Set the full-viewport perspective stage to direction:ltr.
rtlDecisions.why: The source stage uses an absolute child with left:700 and no right/inset counterpart. LTR restores the source static-position origin; without it, inherited RTL anchored the card at the far-left edge and broke the centered composition.

rtlDecisions.action: Wrapped every reused Card in an explicit direction:ltr geometry context.
rtlDecisions.why: The fixture contains only geometric bars and an avatar, not translatable UI text. Preserving its original LTR arrangement keeps the source placeholder faithful and avoids introducing a meaningless mirrored avatar/line placement.

rtlDecisions.what: Diagonal clone spread (dx=64*idx, dy=-34*idx), rotateY(16deg), and translateZ depth
rtlDecisions.action: Kept the original signs and perspective origin after centering the stage.
rtlDecisions.why: The source prompt defines this as physical 3D depth/echo staging, not a reading-order cascade. Persian f45/f55 inspection shows the queue fans up-right with the same recognizable depth rhythm and stays inside the 1920px frame.

rtlDecisions.what: Clone queue order, opacity, timing, and merge
rtlDecisions.action: Kept reverse render order, seven clones, seed 3, opacity decay, 1.6-frame stagger, 25-frame hold, 10-frame merge, 18-frame spring pop, fps, dimensions, easing, and all numeric constants unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These values encode the source's spread-then-synchronous-merge narrative and are motion fidelity requirements.

timing.notes: The Persian title is shorter than the source English title, but the title remains in the same fixed top box and does not alter any animation beat. No timing constants, spring parameters, easing curves, seed, fps, size, or duration changed.

font.reason: Loaded variable Vazirmatn 800 provides reliable Persian glyph coverage and a compact, heavy UI/display sans suitable for the original bold heading. The fixture is geometric and contains no text.

rasterHandling.details: No raster or video assets are used. The reused Card is DOM geometry only and contains no baked foreign-language text.

visualVerification.notes: After the fix, the Persian f0 card visually matches the upstream f0 position at approximately x=700–1190; f45/f55 show the centered up-right clone fan; f68 shows the post-merge settled card; f119 shows the final resting state. The harness produced only the upstream original f0 still because the available original MP4 contains no extractable later-frame stills, so later original-frame viewing is unavailable rather than claimed.

concerns: The available upstream comparison render exposes only original f0 as a still; later original PNGs are not present, so later-beat comparison is documented from the source prompt, unchanged motion code, and Persian render inspection.
Frame 119 is the last valid frame of the exclusive 120-frame composition.
